description: This file defines a Java class named ReleaseInteropTransferHandler that implements the processing of a command to release an interoperation transfer. It uses annotations for dependency injection, transaction management, and command handling, and delegates the core logic to an InteropService.

classes.name: ReleaseInteropTransferHandler
classes.description: A handler class for processing release transfer commands within the interoperation package. It uses dependency injection for the InteropService and manages transactions for the command processing.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JSON command to release a transfer by delegating to the interopService.
